title: A notification moves its workspace to the top of the sidebar (notifications.attention.moveToTop, on by default since 2026-11-09). Four workspaces, the shown one first; a cmux notify for the last one moves it up to the top of the unpinned rows. Record with: cmux-ci capture SHA --state scripts/cmux-next/media/states/sidebar-notified-to-top.json
